items.title: Gucci's New 'Made in China' Sneaker Breaks With Italian Tradition
items.summary: Trade press reports Gucci began selling two sneaker models, including Demna's debut 'Drip' style (~EUR800), manufactured in China rather than Italy for the first time, prompting analyst warnings that this risks brand-positioning damage during a price/value credibility fight.

items.title: 'China has arrived': From $1,000 Gucci sneakers to German cars
items.summary: Macro piece uses Gucci's China-made sneaker as the lead example of Chinese manufacturers moving up into premium categories that historically defined European industrial prestige, framing it as a symbolic erosion of Europe's 'top end' competitive moat alongside German auto exports.

items.title: Kering share price movement and corporate disclosures, late September 2026
items.summary: Kering shares closed at EUR223.55 on 29 September, down 2.04% on the day (-1.65% over five sessions); disclosures this month include Causeway Capital Management crossing the 5% ownership threshold and the appointment of Sophie Maddaloni as General Secretary, reflecting continued investor and governance attention on the group as it works through Gucci's turnaround.

items.title: Gucci's Renaissance: Kering CEO Luca de Meo Unveils Strategies
items.summary: De Meo tells investors and press Gucci 'is not vanilla ice cream, it's spicy, sometimes bitter' after a seven-month review, sets an 18-month deadline for group brands to return to growth, and says Kering must reduce its 'excessive dependence' on Gucci by leaning more on Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta and Balenciaga -- candid framing of Gucci as still the group's core problem.

items.title: Demna's Gucci Is Selling a Dream
items.summary: Critic Alexander Fury gives a mixed-positive review of the SS27 'store show', praising Demna's conceptual clarity ('the store is where the fantasy becomes flesh') while flagging that some observers still question whether the staging translates into real commercial pull.

items.title: Gucci SS27, Demna trasforma la sfilata in boutique: la strategia
items.summary: Italian outlet frames the boutique-set show as 'cynical pragmatism', quoting the line 'never like now is fashion desired, but never like now is it so little purchased' to capture the gap between crowded fashion-week streets and quiet stores despite the entry-level Ophidia bag being repriced to EUR690.

items.title: "Gucci by Demna review" TikTok
items.summary: Creator-posted video reviewing Demna's Gucci direction under the #demna #gucci tags, part of a broader wave of TikTok reaction clips (discovery pages such as 'gucci-denma-review' actively trending) split between admiration for the styling shift and skepticism the collections read as 'Balenciaga 2.0'.

items.title: PurseForum Gucci board: Horse-bit Loafers Addicts Club and price-increase threads
items.summary: Active community board with an ongoing 'Horse-bit Loafers Addicts Club' thread (last active 17 September) and prior threads on Gucci price increases; members compare fit, exotic-leather purchases and price creep. Organic buyer chatter, mixed sentiment leaning practical/product-focused rather than emotionally charged; direct page fetch was blocked (403) so this entry relies on search-indexed thread titles/dates only.

items.title: Gucci S/S 2027 Milan thread, forum reaction
items.summary: Forum members call the womenswear 'ABYSMAL' and 'pretentious and bad' with bags dismissed as 'trash'; menswear draws mixed reaction with some praising restraint while others mock the theatrical styling and 'complete vision' framing as recycled from six months earlier and question the commercial 'see now buy now' capsule for reusing existing Ophidia/Marmont styles rather than new designs.
